description: This file handles authentication mechanisms for the LiteLLM Proxy, including API key validation, JWT and OAuth2 authentication, route checks, and related utilities. It defines functions for authenticating WebSocket connections, retrieving and validating API keys or tokens, applying budget constraints, and managing related security logic.
